# MCP error codes

MCP protocol and tools. 222 codes: 6 with a description, 216 without. Format and other subsystems: [Error Codes](README.md).

| Code | Severity | Description | Suggested action |
|------|----------|-------------|------------------|
| `MCP-GENERAL-216` | error | git_merge failed | Check branch name and repository state |
| `MCP-GENERAL-217` | error | git_conflict_status failed | Check repository merge state |
| `MCP-GENERAL-218` | error | git_mark_resolved failed | Check file path and conflict state |
| `MCP-GENERAL-219` | error | create_pull_request failed | Check forge token, repository remote URL, and write mode status |
| `MCP-GENERAL-220` | error | pull_requests handler failed (list/get/comments) | Check forge token, repository remote URL, and PR/MR state filters |
| `MCP-GENERAL-223` | warning | Auto-watch skipped: repository_alias is not a registered activated repo, or its resolved path does not exist | Verify repository_alias is activated (checked via ActivatedRepoManager.user_has_activated_repo, not filesystem existence, so an orphan directory from a partially-failed activation cannot pass the guard) and not stale/deactivated on another cluster node |
